title: 내모남불 ④ 부동산편 · 호가 · 호재 · 영끌

lines.en: Total bubble. Prices have to come down.
Stamp right here, please.
There. Now it only goes up!

lines.text: 사기 전엔 거품, 사고 나면 바닥. 내모남불, 하나.
lines.en: Before buying: a bubble. After buying: rock bottom. Double standard, number one.
I'm… Modapman.

lines.text: 사건 개요. 토요일 오전, 동네 부동산. 전세 만기 두 달 전.
lines.en: Case summary. Saturday morning, the neighborhood realtor. Two months before our jeonse lease ends.
You said we were just looking. Why did you stamp it?
So, how much is our place worth now?
You bought it one minute ago.

lines.tts: 딱 세 판만 하죠. 일 라운드, 호가.
lines.en: Just three rounds. Round one: asking prices.
Dad, what's an asking price?

lines.text: 파는 사람 희망 사항이지. 거래가 돼야 시세야.
lines.en: Just what the seller wishes for. It's only real once it sells.

lines.text: 어? 옆 동이 이 가격에 내놨대!
lines.en: Whoa, the next building just listed at this price!

lines.text: 그럼 우리 집도 이제 이 가격이야. 모 어때~
lines.en: So that's our price now too. So what~

lines.text: 남의 호가는 희망 사항, 우리 호가는 시세. 내모남불, 둘.
lines.en: Their asking price: wishful thinking. Ours: the market price. Double standard, number two.

lines.text: 내 것이 더 비싸 보이는 것. 보유 효과라고 합니다.
lines.en: When what's yours looks pricier. It's called the endowment effect.
Endow… what?

lines.text: 단톡방에서 이 가격 밑으론 내놓지 말재. 좋아요!
lines.en: The complex group chat says nobody list below this. Like!

lines.text: 그건 집값 담합입니다. 법으로 금지돼 있어요.
lines.en: That's price-fixing. It's against the law.
Round two: "good news" and banners.

lines.text: 남의 동네에 역이 생긴다고? 그거 10년 걸려. 설레발이야.
lines.tts: 남의 동네에 역이 생긴다고? 그거 십 년 걸려. 설레발이야.
lines.en: A new station in some other town? That takes ten years. All hype.
Dad, they say a station's coming to OUR town!

lines.text: 확정이야, 확정! 역 생기고, 백화점 생기고, 황금 집이다!
lines.en: It's official! A station, a mall, our house turns to gold!
A banner is not a confirmation.

lines.text: 보고 싶은 소식만 믿는 것, 확증 편향. 내모남불, 셋.
lines.en: Believing only the news you want. Confirmation bias. Double standard, number three.

lines.text: 옆 동네에 소각장? 꼭 필요한 시설이지. 반대하면 이기적이야.
lines.en: An incinerator next town over? We need those. Opposing it is selfish.
Honey, it's in our town.

lines.text: 결사반대! 우리 동네는 절대 안 돼!
lines.en: Over my dead body! Not in our town!

lines.text: 내 뒷마당만은 안 된다, 님비. 내모남불, 넷.
lines.en: Anywhere but my backyard: NIMBY. Double standard, number four.

lines.text: 다들 우리 동네는 안 된다시면… 어디에 짓죠?
lines.en: If every town says "not here"… where do we build it?
Round three: borrowing to the max, and interest.
Dude, I bought a place too. Borrowed every last won.
Every last won? That's reckless. Can you handle the interest?
We maxed out our loan too.

lines.text: 우리 건 레버리지야. 전략이지. 모 어때~
lines.en: Ours is leverage. Strategy. So what~
Dad, you said rent is money thrown away.
Interest is different! It's… an investment cost!

lines.text: 남이 하면 영끌, 내가 하면 레버리지. 내모남불, 다섯, 여섯.
lines.en: When they do it, it's reckless. When I do it, it's leverage. Double standard, five and six.

lines.text: 나만은 괜찮을 거라는 믿음. 낙관 편향이라고 합니다.
lines.en: "I'll be the one who's fine." That's called optimism bias.
…Huh?
Bonus round. Rapid-fire double standards!

lines.text: 남의 단지는 복잡하고, 우리 단지는 대단지!
lines.en: Their complex: too crowded. Ours: a grand complex!

lines.text: 남이 전세 올리면 너무하고, 내가 올리면 시세대로!
lines.en: Their landlord raising the deposit: cruel. Me raising it: just the market rate!

lines.text: 남의 현수막은 흉하고, 우리 현수막은 단합!
lines.en: Their banners: an eyesore. Ours: team spirit!
Double standard: seven, eight, nine!
Dad, did our house go up or down?
…Good question. I checked it every day, and I still don't know.

lines.text: 올라도 내려도, 내 방은 그대로야. 나는 이 놀이터가 좋아.
lines.en: Up or down, my room's the same. And I like this playground.
…You're right. It's a home, not a number.

lines.text: 내가 딱 꼭대기에서 판 거야. 이제 폭락할 거야.
lines.en: I sold right at the top. It's gonna crash now.
The house you sold just went up again.
…Bubble. Total bubble.

lines.text: 못 딴 포도는 시다. 신 포도. 내모남불, 열.
lines.en: The grapes you can't reach are sour. Double standard, number ten.

lines.text: 그 말씀, 일 년 전에도 하셨습니다.
lines.en: You said the exact same thing a year ago.

lines.text: 꼭대기가 아니었습니다. 이건 내모남불이 아닙니다. 그냥 오답.
lines.en: It wasn't the top. That's not a double standard. Just a wrong answer.
…Classic Modapman.
